proposal: Bora Gulari request permission to rebuild accessory structure (boathouse/garage) in a R1 Zone (Single-Family Residential District). This case is appealed because the Board of Zoning Appeals shall be authorized to hear dimensional variance requests for matters that are beyond the scope of Buildings and Safety Engineering Department ten percent (10%) administrative adjustments. Per Section 61-13-128 - Accessory buildings or structures in rear setback; setbacks from principal buildings. No detached accessory building(s) or structure(s) in an R1 or R2 District shall occupy more than fifty percent (50%) of the area of the required rear setback area; the proposed Boathouse exceeds the maximum lot coverage allowed. (Sections 61-13-2 R1 Intensity and Dimensional Standards, 61-13-128 - Accessory buildings or structures in rear setback, 61-4-91(6) Permitted Dimensional Variances, General Dimensional Standards and 61-4-81 Approval Criteria).AP
action: Ms. Teague made a motion Grant Dimensional Variances to rebuild accessory structure (boathouse/garage) in a R1 Zone (Single-Family Residential District). . Seconded by Ms. Grant
